title: Chapter 443 He Is A Madman
content:
Chapter 443 He Is A Madman

In the Huangcheng Square.

There is less than a day left before the first settlement of the combat power list ends.

Countless strong people present looked indifferent, waiting for the arrival of the last strong people.

Mo Chou looked at the ranking on the combat power list, looked at it for a long time, and nodded slightly.

Their human race has the most powerful people, and many of them are in a very high position, but at this moment, he suddenly frowned slightly.

"Strange, why are there so few strong people in the Heavenly Demon Clan? It's not right. You can't see the strong people in the Heavenly Demon Clan in the top twenty."

This is really incredible. Some time ago, a terrifying demonic aura broke out in the Tiande Clan, and the Tiande Clan has also been in a very strong momentum recently.

Why is it that now that there are so few strong people on the list?

Could it be that the Heavenly Demon Clan is a paper tiger?

Mochou shook his head slightly, it was unlikely.

As far as he knows, no famous monsters of the Heavenly Demon Clan appeared, which means that the high-end combat power of the Heavenly Demon Clan did not choose to come to Huangcheng to compete for the list.

So, what are the strong men of the Heavenly Demon Clan doing now?

Mo Chou, who couldn't figure it out, finally decided to ask. After all, the entire Chaos Realm has now unified the front line. If the top strong men of the Heavenly Demon Clan do not go to fight, wouldn't it be a drag on them?

Then, under the surprised gaze of the strong men, Mo Chou slowly headed towards a small Heavenly Demon Clan powerhouse.

This is one of the few powerful people in the Heavenly Demon Clan present.

"The Fire Crane Demon Lord."

Mo Chou called out softly to a middle-aged man with his eyes closed and resting in a fiery red robe.

Hearing this, the Fire Trunk Demon Lord immediately opened his eyes and looked at Mo Chou, feeling a little flattered, "Master Mo Guardian, I wonder what is going on?"

Mochou serves as a guardian in the Human Emperor Palace, so the strong people in the Chaos Realm generally call Mochou the Mo protector.

Mo Chou looked around and his eyes were immediately withdrawn.

Then, Mo Chou whispered: "Why don't you strong men from the Heavenly Demon Clan come to Huangcheng? Don't tell me, your Heavenly Demon Clan doesn't even look down on the treasures on the combat power list."

Hearing this, the Fire Trunk Demon Lord hurriedly said, "Master Mo, the clan leader and the others are still in seclusion within the clan. As for when they will come, I don't know."

"In retreat? When has it been, and he is still in retreat?"

Mo Chou couldn't believe that the combat power list was born, and many old monsters in the Chaos Realm had long disappeared. All the dead-end Lao monsters appeared, and the strong men of the Heavenly Demon Clan were still in seclusion.

The Fire Trunk Heavenly Lord was silent.

He is just a great demon of the supreme earth-class heaven, so how could he know so many things in the clan?

As if he remembered something, Huohe Tianzun suddenly said, "By the way, Lord Ao Qing is also in my Tiande Clan."

"Mr. Ao Qing!"

Mo Chou was slightly stunned. It is said that it was Lord Lu Xue's protective beast.

It seems that something happened in the Tiande Clan that people don’t know about.

Mochou didn't ask any more questions, and then returned to his place.

He doesn't have to worry too much about the Heavenly Demon Clan. Since Ao Qing is in the Heavenly Demon Clan, it means that the Heavenly Demon Clan is still within the control of the Chaos Realm and there will be no mistakes.

Looking up again at the combat power list.

At this time, the top spot was already the leader of the Holy Spirit clan.

"Oh, Lord Lord, when will you come?"

"The Lord of the Palace is here!!"

Mo Chou just sighed when suddenly someone from the Imperial Palace cheered.

"Um?!"

The people suddenly became turbulent and looked in one direction.

I saw two figures slowly walking towards here.

The two went hand in hand, one of them had a tough face and a handsome appearance. After carrying it with one hand, there was a faint smile on his face.

The other person has an old face, and it seems that the leaves fall in the wind and will wither at any time, but in fact it is hidden deep and contains the universe. As you walk step by step, it brings a terrifying sense of oppression.

"It's really the Lord of the Palace!"

"That's great, Lord Lord of the Palace is finally here."

"Huh? Who is the one next to the Lord of the Palace, who can actually go along with the Lord of the Palace?"

Mochou took the lead and came to Wu Hui's front.

"Mr. Lord, you are here."

"Who is this?"

Mochou looked at the old man beside Wu Hui.

Shi Zhong said lightly: "I was the second-generation palace master. I served as the right guardian."

As soon as these words were spoken, everyone in the audience was stunned.

Many older generation strong men present recalled them one after another.

Back then, the name Shi Zhong was already very loud, just like Mo Chou now.

Hearing this, Mochou quickly looked solemn and saluted Shi Zhong respectfully, "My younger brother, Mochou, have seen Senior Shi Zhong."

"We have met Senior Shi Zhong."

The spirits around them sighed in their hearts that they are worthy of being the human race. Since the establishment of the Human Emperor Palace, the human race has risen rapidly. In this era, whether in terms of strength or foundation, the human race is not inferior to any clan in the Chaos Realm, and is the absolute overlord!

"That's great. With the Lord of the Palace and Senior Shi Zhong, the top two in the combat power list, aren't they all from my human race?"

"That's not."

And at this moment, Shi Zhong and Wu Hui suddenly looked back.

At the same time, everyone present suddenly felt a cruel aura.

This breath makes your scalp numb and you feel uncomfortable all over.

Evil cultivator?

Everyone thought so.

But then, a figure appeared in front of everyone.

A human man could not see his face, all covered by his messy hair, but the extraordinary person could be seen from his fierce aura.

Definitely a ruthless person.

When they saw this person, most of the people present had question marks on their heads.

Don't recognize it.

Wu Hui smiled, he found this person.

Shi Zhong looked at the man and his brows gradually frowned.

In the crowd, when a powerful human race saw this person, he felt as if he was electrocuted, trembling all over and sweating profusely.

"It's him, it's really him. How could he come out? How could he be?!"

Many years ago, he was imprisoned in the terrifying heavenly prison of the human race for committing an incident.

There, he met the existence he feared most in his life.

At that time, he had a broken heart and a broken spirit.

But he was lucky too.

This existence will not come out of the prison.

Not long after, he was rescued by the family behind him at a huge cost.

He thought he would never meet this man again in his life, but now, this man has come out.

War Madman, this is the name of this man.

"You're here."

Looking at the man walking in front of him, Wu Hui whispered.

Hearing this, Zhan Madman looked up mechanically and looked at Wu Hui, and said, "Wu Hui, I really want to kill you."

“…”

Silence, ghostly silence.

Most of the wasteland squares seemed to have been pressed.

Everyone was stunned, staring at Wu Hui and Zhan Madman in a daze.

This man, is this man a lunatic?

Everyone shouted in their hearts, but they were all so proud that they dared not show off.
